title: The season becomes an index
governingQuestion: What survives when a temporary week is retained as structured memory?

publication.author: Rayven-Nikkita Collins
publication.status: publication-ready text; human recording, permissions, specialist and RN owner-final gates remain

essay.headline: The season becomes an index
essay.opening: A season becomes history only if its records remain addressable.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: The official collection archive exposes seasons back to 2006 and maintains brand and season indexes.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: Museum interpretation, organizer archives and stream platforms preserve different kinds of fashion memory under different rights.

sections.heading: Next / limit
sections.copy: No single public archive joins every invitation, technical credit, show file, rights record, textile provenance, stream and correction history.

essay.closing: Tokyo’s technical identity is not one gadget. It is the chain of interfaces that decides what can enter, travel, translate, trade and remain.
